examples.arabic: مكتب المدير صار مطبخ صغير لتحضير الوجبات السخنة لكل الناس كل بعد الظهر.
examples.english: The principal's office has become a small kitchen to prepare hot meals for everyone every afternoon.
examples.transliteration: Maktab el-mudiir saar matbakh sghir la-tahdiir el-wajabat el-sukhne la-kel el-naas kel baad el-duhur.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: المكتب كتير مرتاح بس انا دايما مشغول
examples.english: The office is very comfortable but I am always busy.
examples.transliteration: al maktab kteer mertah bas ana dayman mashghool

examples.arabic: بالمكتب رفيقي قالي انت اكلت الغداء
examples.english: At the office, my friend asked me,
examples.transliteration: Bil maktab rfi'i 'aali enta akalt el ghada?

examples.arabic: معلش، يا عمو، ممكن تدلني على مكتب جمعية "أمل مستدامة" قريبة من هون؟
examples.english: Excuse me, uncle, could you show me the way to the office of the "Sustainable Hope" association near here?
examples.transliteration: Ma'lesh, ya 'ammu, mumkin tedellni 'ala maktab jam'iyyat "Amal Mustadama" 'areebeh min hon?
examples.storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

examples.arabic: ليلى بلشت شغل جديد بالمكتب هاد الاسبوع
examples.english: Laila started a new job at the office this week.
examples.transliteration: Layla ballashat shoghl jdid bil maktab had el isbu'.

examples.arabic: اليوم كان اول يوم شغل لي بالمكتب الجديد
examples.english: Today was my first day of work at the new office.
examples.transliteration: El-yōm kān awwal yōm shughl lī bil-maktab el-jadīd
